# WinMUGEN docs for Coding Agents

Primary agent instructions:
- AGENTS.md

Generated local corpus:
- generated/index.json
- generated/full/cns.md
- generated/full/sctrls.md
- generated/full/trigger.md
- generated/full/air.md
- generated/sections/cns/
- generated/sections/sctrls/
- generated/sections/trigger/
- generated/sections/air/

Hand-written local references:
- docs/CNS_CORE.md
- docs/COMPATIBILITY.md

Lookup rule:
1. Read AGENTS.md.
2. Search generated/index.json by exact controller, trigger, CNS heading, or AIR heading.
3. Open the referenced split Markdown section.
4. Read only directly relevant related sections as needed.
5. Use docs/ for compatibility and operational notes.
6. Do not regenerate the corpus or fetch upstream web documentation during character-coding work.
